svg.aria-label: Anum Sagheer, Data Scientist and Applied AI and ML Engineer. MS Data Science, University of Maryland, College Park, 2026. BE Information Science. Data and AI Analyst at EY. ML Intern at WorkOnGrid. Builds: generative AI and agentic systems with LLMs, RAG, LangGraph, AI agents, tool calling and fine-tuning; machine learning and experimentation with classification, forecasting, anomaly detection, A/B testing and model evaluation; data engineering with Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, Snowflake and ETL pipelines; MLOps and cloud with MLflow, Docker, FastAPI, GitHub Actions, AWS and GCP. Open to full-time roles in data science, applied AI and ML engineering. Based in Georgia, open to relocation across the US. Contact anumsagheer02 at gmail dot com and linkedin.com/in/anum-sagheer.
